headline: Simbhaoli Sugars Limited: 2nd Committee of Creditors Meeting in CIRP
sum: Simbhaoli Sugars Limited, a listed sugar manufacturer, conducted its 2nd Committee of Creditors meeting on 10–13 August 2026 as part of an ongoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process under the Insolvency & Bankruptcy Code, 2016.
implication: COC meetings are critical gates in CIRP: this 2nd meeting likely reviewed resolution plans, creditor claims, and approval thresholds under IBC s. 30(4)-a key juncture determining viability of standalone resolution vs. liquidation.
detail: Simbhaoli Sugars Limited, a listed entity, has filed or is subject to a CIRP petition. The 2nd COC meeting was held over 10–13 August 2026 and intimated to the NSE post facto on 18 August 2026. Under IBC protocol, COC meetings deliberate on resolution plans, creditor recovery, and approval of insolvency professional conduct. The outcome of this meeting-approval of a resolution plan, further extensions, or discharge-would determine next regulatory and commercial steps.

framework.note: Committee of Creditors voting threshold (66% by value) for approval of resolution plan; central to CIRP progression.
